# ghost/rpn-calculator

RPNcalc (F-Droid): a reverse Polish notation (stack) calculator. Type numbers, press Enter, apply operators and read the stack, or evaluate a whole RPN expression. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/rpn-calculator
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/rpn-calculator open_calc --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/rpn-calculator clear_all --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/rpn-calculator type_number --device <serial> --param value=<value>
ghost skill run ghost/rpn-calculator enter --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/rpn-calculator operate --device <serial> --param op=<op>
ghost skill run ghost/rpn-calculator evaluate --device <serial> --param expression=<expression>
ghost skill run ghost/rpn-calculator get_stack --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_calc`: Open the RPN calculator
- `clear_all`: Clear the RPN calculator stack
- `type_number`: Type the number 12.5 on the RPN calculator
- `enter`: Press Enter on the RPN calculator
- `operate`: Add the top two numbers on the RPN calculator
- `evaluate`: Evaluate 3 4 + 2 * in reverse Polish notation
- `get_stack`: What is on the RPN calculator stack?
